cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavy bag. I taught you to lift properly, but I still care more about your back than you do about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice offer. You're remembering my example. But you've a way to go before you catch up; I'll keep carrying it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're learning. Take the light end and keep your knees bent, like I showed you. I'll take the books; someone has to care that little bit more.
